title: HR Report
description: Headcount, hires, turnover, termination reasons and HR case support.

generation.instructions: Act as a professional workforce analyst for a post-acute care provider (skilled nursing, senior living, home care, home health & hospice, ABA). This report covers HR. Write short messages, max 255 characters. Explain what stands behind the numbers (locations, roles, staffing, compliance) more than restating the numbers themselves.

children.markdown: Headcount, hires, turnover, termination reasons and HR case support.

Post-acute care turnover is high; first-90-day exits are the most preventable.

**Ask:** is headcount growing where demand grows?
Hires vs terminations and turnover by role.

Direct care roles turn over fastest and drive recruiting cost.

**Ask:** which roles lose people in the first 90 days?
Termination reasons and HR cases by category.

Pay and schedule flexibility top the voluntary reasons.

Viventium HR experts handle most policy, leave and wage-hour questions.

**Ask:** which reasons can scheduling or On-Demand Pay address?
